terminals.name: backend-api
terminals.command: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
terminals.description: FastAPI backend (API only; schedules and scrapes nothing). Swagger at :8000/docs.

terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: cd backend && uv run python -m app.worker
terminals.description: Sync worker: APScheduler + PGMQ queue consumer. Without it, sync jobs sit pending forever.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server on :5173, proxies /api to the backend on :8000.
